name: Industrious Labs
summary: Campaigns to cut emissions from heavy industry (steel, aluminium, cement, industrial heat, landfills) in the US, through rules, company pressure and community organising; its 501(c)(3) is Industrious Education Fund.

spending.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/510198509 (Tides Foundation's Form 990 for 2024, Schedule I: $3,123,870 granted to Climate Strategies Lab LLC, Industrious Labs' operating company, which publishes no accounts; Industrious Education Fund, its 501(c)(3), https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/992396851, spent $38,667 in 2024, all start-up costs, no programmes until 2025)

lines.label: Steel, aluminium, cement, clean industrial heat, landfill and field-building campaigns (every programme)
lines.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/510198509 (Tides Foundation's 2024 grants to Climate Strategies Lab LLC, $3,123,870, the only public figure for Industrious Labs' spending; no programme split is published).
